voxvelo.connection.failed: Connection failed, see the log for details
voxvelo.config.telemetry: Power %s W    Cadence %s rpm    Heart rate %s bpm
voxvelo.config.bluetooth_page.tip: Connect your smart trainer, a separate power meter and a heart rate sensor. A power meter's watts and a heart rate sensor's bpm take priority over the trainer's.
voxvelo.bluetooth.title: Bluetooth Devices
voxvelo.bluetooth.hint: Press Scan, then pick a role for each of your devices.
voxvelo.bluetooth.scan.tip: Search for nearby smart trainers, power meters and heart rate sensors. Other Bluetooth devices are not listed.
voxvelo.bluetooth.connect.tip: Connect to the saved device again. It is searched for first if it has not been seen yet.
voxvelo.bluetooth.role.trainer.tip: Use this device as your smart trainer (FTMS). It sets your power and takes the resistance.
voxvelo.bluetooth.role.power_meter.tip: Use this device as a separate power meter. Its watts take priority over the trainer's.
voxvelo.bluetooth.role.heart_rate.tip: Use this device as your heart rate sensor. Its bpm takes priority over the one the trainer relays.
voxvelo.bluetooth.trainer_settings.tip: Resistance from the terrain, virtual gears and your bike's gear ratio and wheel size.
voxvelo.trainer_settings.title: Trainer Settings
voxvelo.road.title: Road & Terrain
voxvelo.road.hint: Road follow keeps the bike centred on a road made of these blocks.
voxvelo.road.follow.tip: Steer along the road by itself while a road made of your blocks is ahead. Your steering takes over when there is none. Works together with the keyboard, the trainer and a controller.
voxvelo.junction.title: Junction ahead
voxvelo.config.obc.tip: Connect an OpenBikeControl device, such as the BikeControl phone app, for steering, brake and gears.
voxvelo.config.road.tip: Hands-free steering: turn road following on, choose which blocks count as road, how wide a road may be, and the junction question.
voxvelo.config.stats.tip: The overlay of other riders' watts and heart rate, and what you share with them.
voxvelo.rider.stats.tip: Show the list of other riders with their watts, speed, cadence and heart rate. The Toggle Rider Stats key does the same.
voxvelo.rider.share_watts.tip: Let other riders see your watts.
voxvelo.rider.share_hr.tip: Let other riders see your heart rate. It is health data, so nothing is sent while this is off.
voxvelo.trainer.disconnect.tip: Disconnect, and do not reconnect by itself until you pick the device again.
voxvelo.trainer.forget.tip: Forget the saved device so it is no longer reconnected automatically.
voxvelo.config.auto_connect.tip: Reconnect to your trainer, power meter and heart rate sensor when you join a world.
voxvelo.config.resistance.tip: Let the game set your trainer's resistance from the slope and the ground. Needs a trainer that supports it.
voxvelo.config.intensity.tip: How strongly slope and ground change the resistance. 100 percent matches the game's physics, 0 keeps the trainer flat.
voxvelo.config.slope_window.tip: Blocks ahead and behind over which the slope is averaged. A longer window smooths single steps, which suits slow-reacting trainers.
voxvelo.obc.mode.tip: How to look for devices: over the local network, over Bluetooth, or both. The phone app uses the network.
voxvelo.obc.rescan.tip: Search again for OpenBikeControl devices on the network and over Bluetooth.
voxvelo.obc.connect.tip: Connect to the address you typed.
voxvelo.obc.manual.tip: The device's address as host:port, as shown in the app. Use it when the device is not found automatically.
voxvelo.road.add.tip: Add the block id or #tag you typed to the road blocks.
voxvelo.road.add_under.tip: Add the block you are standing on to the road blocks.
voxvelo.road.add_looking.tip: Add the block you are looking at to the road blocks.
voxvelo.road.reset.tip: Back to the default road blocks: smooth stone and its slab (what the track command builds), stone and gravel.
voxvelo.road.input.tip: A block id such as minecraft:gravel, or a tag such as #minecraft:sand.
voxvelo.road.half_width.tip: Roads wider than this on each side count as open ground, and road following lets go of the steering there.
voxvelo.road.junction.tip: Ask whether to go left or right at junctions while road following. Off: the widest way is taken.
voxvelo.road.cooldown.tip: The least time between two questions. Junctions inside it are decided automatically.
voxvelo.config.virtual_shifting.tip: Lets the game's twelve gears change the load on your trainer, so shifting up feels heavier and shifting down lighter, although the trainer has no gears.
voxvelo.config.physical_ratio.tip: The real gear ratio you ride on the trainer, chainring over cog, for example 50/20 = 2.5. Virtual gear 6 matches it.
voxvelo.config.wheel_circumference.tip: Circumference of your trainer's wheel in meters. Used to work out speed from cadence when the trainer reports no speed.
voxvelo.rider.heart_graph.tip: Show the heart rate graph in the top-right corner while you ride.
voxvelo.rider.junction_hud.tip: Show the left or right question on screen when a junction comes up while road following.
voxvelo.stats.title: HUD & Rider Stats
voxvelo.rider.hud.tip: Show the small panel with power, cadence, speed, grade and gear while you ride.
voxvelo.obc.title: OpenBikeControl
voxvelo.obc.hint: Start BikeControl or another OBC device first.
voxvelo.obc.manual_invalid: Enter a host and port like 127.0.0.1:8080
voxvelo.obc.none_found: No devices found. Press Rescan to search again.
voxvelo.obc.network_unavailable: Network discovery unavailable; enter the address below instead
voxvelo.config.ride_recording.tip: Record a ride session, see its stats, export it as a FIT file or draw it on a map.
voxvelo.ride.title: Ride Recording
voxvelo.ride.start.tip: Records one sample per second while you ride: position, distance, speed, power, cadence, heart rate and grade. Time off the bike is left out. The Start / Stop Ride Recording key (R) does the same.
voxvelo.ride.stop.tip: Ends the session and shows its stats.
voxvelo.ride.export.tip: Saves the ride as a FIT activity file in .minecraft/voxvelo/rides, ready for Strava, Garmin Connect, intervals.icu and others. It is filed as a virtual ride.
voxvelo.ride.map.tip: The server draws the route on a locked map with the terrain you rode through. Costs one empty map from your inventory (free in creative). Needs the fitness build on the server.
voxvelo.ride.fit_position.tip: Write positions into the FIT file so the route shows as a map online. Minecraft has no globe: the ride starts at a made-up spot in the Atlantic (set in voxvelo-fitness.json) with one block as one metre. Off: distance only, like an indoor ride.
voxvelo.ride.open_folder.tip: Opens .minecraft/voxvelo/rides, where FIT files are saved.
voxvelo.ride.idle: Not recording. Press Start, or R while riding.
voxvelo.ride.empty: The last session has no riding in it.
voxvelo.ride.unsaved_warning: Starting a new ride discards this unsaved ride.
voxvelo.ride.unsaved_export: Export as FIT first to keep it.
voxvelo.ride.map_unavailable: This server cannot draw ride maps
voxvelo.ride.map_given: Your ride map is in your inventory.
voxvelo.ride.map_needs_paper: A ride map needs an empty map in your inventory.
voxvelo.ride.map_cooldown: Wait a few seconds before drawing another ride map.
voxvelo.ride.map_failed: Could not draw the ride map.
voxel_fitness.settings.title: Fitness
voxvelo.road.nothing_under: There is no block under you
